tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: chalk with a touch of grass. Cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, table header, neutral chips. Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px card and row borders, dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text, figures. 14.8:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meta lines, table headers. 8.5:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, scope lines, footer notes, the unavailable dash. 5.6:1 on ground, 5.1:1 on surface-sunken. The lightest text color on light surfaces.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Scoreboard green: the header, the score header of a game, the home hero, the footer. The dark band every page opens with.

tokens.name: board-2
tokens.usage: Raised cells on the board: the nav row on a phone, line-score cells, the selected day of the calendar.

tokens.name: on-board
tokens.usage: Text and icons on board and board-2. 11.6:1 and 8.4:1.

tokens.name: on-board-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on board: meta lines, the losing score, disabled nav. 7.5:1 on board, 5.4:1 on board-2.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Scoreboard yellow: figures and the current item on the board (8.1:1 on board), the primary button on the board, the fill of performance chips. A fill or a mark on light surfaces, never text there (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of notable-reason chips and of today in the calendar. Text on it: signal-ink or ink.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal-tint. 6.9:1.

tokens.name: stitch
tokens.usage: Ball-stitch red: the winner marker, the stitch in the logo, the pitch a callout points at. A small graphic mark on light surfaces only (4.7:1 on white); never text, never a status, never on board.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Grass green: links, the primary button on light surfaces, selection. 5.4:1 on ground, 5.95:1 on surface; white on it 5.95:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, round chips, days in the selected range. Text on it: brand or ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on brand fills.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status text: supported, held up. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status text: warning, small sample, starter changed, partly held up.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Status text: unsupported, did not hold up, error notices. Darker than stitch; never emphasis.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind bad text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light surfaces: 3px solid, 2px offset. On board the ring is signal.

tokens.name: pitch-four-seam
tokens.usage: Four-seam fastball. Fastball family: drawn as a circle.

tokens.name: pitch-sinker
tokens.usage: Sinker. Fastball family: circle.

tokens.name: pitch-cutter
tokens.usage: Cutter. Fastball family: circle.

tokens.name: pitch-slider
tokens.usage: Slider. Breaking family: drawn as a diamond.

tokens.name: pitch-sweeper
tokens.usage: Sweeper. Breaking family: diamond.

tokens.name: pitch-curveball
tokens.usage: Curveball. Breaking family: diamond.

tokens.name: pitch-changeup
tokens.usage: Changeup. Offspeed family: drawn as a square.

tokens.name: pitch-splitter
tokens.usage: Splitter. Offspeed family: square.

tokens.name: pitch-other
tokens.usage: Any pitch type not in the map: drawn as a ring, always named in the legend.

tokens.name: team-fallback
tokens.usage: Team badge fill when the abbreviation is unknown. Team colors themselves live in lib/teamColors.ts (approximate, unlicensed) and are not tokens.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title on desktop; home hero on a phone.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Section titles, starter names, card titles.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The final score on the board of a game page. 36px in list rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile values, final-line figures, line-score cells. Every featured number is a scoreboard numeral.

styles.name: title-md
styles.sample: What we asked before the game
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, row titles, team names in rows.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: He struck out 11 and walked one.
styles.usage: Report prose on the game page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each report says only what the data supports.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Written before the game, on Oct 28, 2026.
styles.usage: Meta lines, origin line, table cells. Figures in running text and tables use tabular figures of this family.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels of tiles, fields, chips and table headers. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Scope captions and footer notes. The smallest size in the system.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; tile inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile padding; gap between rows of a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on a phone; page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on a phone; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tiles, inputs, buttons, calendar days.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Notices, nested panels, line-score cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The board of a game page and the home hero on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Team badges and dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips and popovers only. Cards are flat with a 1px line.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum page width on desktop (replaces the 768px column).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of report prose.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable target.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Phone to tablet: lists become two columns, starters sit side by side.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: archive becomes a table, game page gains the side rail.
